scenes.label: Entertain
scenes.note: Lights dim to 30%, shades close, the projector warms up and surround sound comes on.

scenes.label: Bedtime
scenes.note: Lights fade out, shades lower, doors lock, the alarm arms and the temperature drops for the night.

scenes.label: Away
scenes.note: Everything switches off, doors lock, cameras arm and you get an alert on your phone.

scenes.label: Open
scenes.note: Lights come up, the building reaches temperature, background music starts and staff key cards unlock the doors.

scenes.label: Meeting
scenes.note: Boardroom lights dim, the display and video call system wake up and the room cools for a full table.

scenes.label: Closed
scenes.note: Lights switch off, doors go card-only, cameras record, the alarm arms and the manager gets a phone alert.
